container: Technology has transformed society by changing how people communicate, work, learn, and solve problems. Smartphones and social media connect families across distances, while online services make information and essential resources easier to reach. In workplaces, automation improves efficiency and creates new careers, though it can also replace some traditional jobs. Digital classrooms offer flexible learning, but unequal access to devices and reliable internet can widen existing gaps. Technology also raises concerns about privacy, misinformation, and excessive screen time. Its effects depend on the choices people make. Responsible choices can help innovation benefit everyone in society.
